age.evidence: All animals tested were between 2 and 6 months of age

sex.evidence: N = 18 -22 WT mice/sex and 8 -9 KO mice/ sex

dosing.doses_raw: 1, 10, and 50 mg/kg (0.8, 7.9, and 39 mg/kg active 5-MeO-DMT, respectively)
dosing.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT hemifumarate was delivered at 1, 10, and 50 mg/kg (0.8, 7.9, and 39 mg/kg active 5-MeO-DMT, respectively) ... administered via intraperitoneal injection

handling.evidence: Mice were habituated to the behavioral suite for 1 h prior to experiments and also habituated to the investigator via direct handling for three consecutive days prior to any behavioral testing.

group_housing.evidence: Weaned animals were housed in 2 to 5 animals of the same sex per cage with mixed genotypes

day_night_flipped.evidence: kept on a 7:00 to 19:00 light cycle with ad libitum access to food and water

assays.assay_description: Mice injected i.p. with 5-MeO-DMT (1, 10, 50 mg/kg) were placed in a 40 x 40 cm open field chamber and recorded for 20 min; head twitches were manually scored by two blinded observers.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were habituated to the behavioral suite for 1 h prior to experiments (room habituation, not apparatus habituation)

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were injected with varying doses of 5-MeO-DMT, placed in the same open field chamber as for the OFT, and activity was recorded using overhead cameras for 20 min

food_restriction.evidence: Standard open field chamber with no food provided during recording

water_restriction.evidence: Standard open field chamber with no water provided during recording

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were injected with varying doses of 5-MeO-DMT, placed in the same open field chamber ... and activity was recorded using overhead cameras for 20 min

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT elicited head twitches dose-dependently. INMT KO mice showed reduced HTR compared to WT at the highest dose (50 mg/kg), with no sex effect, suggesting reduced 5-HT2AR responsiveness in KO mice.
outcomes.statistics: dose × genotype interaction; F(3,99) = 4.573, P = 0.0048; at 50 mg/kg F(1,26) = 6.978, P = 0.0138
outcomes.evidence: INMT KO mice, regardless of sex, displayed reduced 5-MeO-induced HTR at 50 mg/kg (Figure 5D; F (1,26) = 6.978, P = 0.0138).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total number of head twitches elicited by varying doses of 5-MeO-DMT

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total number of head twitches reported as a single count over the session

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or transitions reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is a pharmacologically induced behaviour, not in the natural ethological repertoire

B5_social.evidence: Mouse tested alone in open field chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTR behavior was scored by two blinded, trained observers

E1_environment_type.evidence: placed in the same open field chamber as for the OFT

E2_shelter.evidence: Open field chamber has no shelter

E3_bedding.evidence: Open field chamber with bare floor, cleaned with 70% ethanol between animals

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in open field chamber

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in test chamber

E6_spatial.evidence: 40 cm x 40 cm opaque gray open field chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: Mouse tested alone in open field chamber

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in the testing apparatus

D2_session_duration.evidence: activity was recorded using overhead cameras for 20 min

judge_notes: Only the Head-Twitch Response assay involved direct administration of a psychedelic (5-MeO-DMT) to rodents. All other behavioural tests (FST, OFT, EPM, FC/FE, CPP, NOR, SAB, 3-CSI) were used to phenotype INMT KO vs WT mice without psychedelic administration and were therefore excluded per scoring rules.
All three candidates agreed on the HTR as the sole scorable assay; their scores were nearly identical and were adopted with high confidence.

Direction set to 'decrease' (KO vs WT reduction at top dose) consistent with qwen and glm; gptoss labeled it 'increase' based on the dose effect of 5-MeO-DMT itself, but the primary reported result framing is the genotype-mediated reduction.
doses_mg_per_kg kept as nominal administered hemifumarate doses (1, 10, 50) as paper labels them; active-base equivalents noted in evidence.
